newsitem.title: USA: Trinity seeks rehearing of patent case.
newsitem.headline: Trinity seeks rehearing of patent case.

text.p: Trinity Industries said on Monday that it will seek a rehearing of a patent case that Johnstown America Industries Inc filed against it.

A U.S. Appeals Court reversed and remanded a 1996 U.S. District Court ruling and said Trinity's Alumniator II coal gondola freight car infringed upon Johnstown's patent, Johnston said earlier in a separate statement.
Trinity's ultimate liability or damages in this matter are difficult to assess, but Trinity's management believes that the final outcome is not likely to materially hurt its financial position.
However, Trinity said there can be no assurance that the outcome of such litigation would not be material to the results of a particular reporting period.
